title: Jesus... I've Missed Every Sunday This Month 🌙
topic: she works night shifts and has missed church for a month, and feels like God now works a different shift

bible.text: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've missed every Sunday this month. 🌙

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Night shift. I sleep through the service and watch the livestream at 2am like a rerun.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I don't keep office hours. I was there at 3am when the monitor alarmed.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But it says don't stop meeting. I feel like I'm drifting.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Find one believer on your shift and pray together. Two is the smallest church there is.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Come back when the rota frees. I'm not counting Sundays. I'm counting you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Which Sunday will you make it back? 👇
